name: Mezzanine Finance Funds benchmark
description: Construction of a benchmark and performance evaluation framework for mezzanine finance funds to compare fund returns and risk metrics.
evaluation_method: financial performance and risk metrics (e.g., return, IRR, Sharpe ratio) and regression error metrics (e.g., MSE)
general_score_metric: return and risk metrics (e.g., IRR, Sharpe ratio)
reputation: An academic, domain-specific benchmark published in the Journal of Private Equity; used in niche finance/real-estate research but not a broad ML community standard.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark; potential small/sample-limited datasets and proprietary data constraints; results depend heavily on financial assumptions and may not generalize across markets.
